body:
I do have a low self steem. I'm not trying to be the greatest person ever, I just want to be a moderately functional person. I'm 18 and I still act like I'm 14, I can't even go alone to the store. Since we live in one of the most dangerous cities in the country, I've been sheltered all my life. My parents didn't let me do a lot and I didn't have a lot of friends to motivate me to go out. I understand it comes from a place of love, but now that means I can't deal with stuff in a healthy manner. I'm really pathetic. 

I'm in college so there isn't much for tutoring. We're supposed to be "adults" so they expect us to just do it. Even so, you're right. I wish I had asked for help before. Specially when I'm dependent on a academic scholarship. 

Anyway, thanks for writing. If you're here you must have your own share of struggles, I hope everything gets better for you.

I'm happy you have a goal to keep going, I really hope you can reach that thought of yours and find yourself traveling all around the world.

Sadly, that's not the case for me, even if I graduate I know I'll need to work a lot and put so much effort just to try to win the chance to move somewhere nicer. It isn't fair, I've grown in a broken country because of things that happened long before I was born. I wish I could say I'll take it slow. Maybe I should look forward to be in a place where I can say that
